Dear NAAMII Hiring Team,

I am writing to express my interest in the Website Management Intern position at NAAMII. As a junior digital marketer with a strong technical foundation in web development and content management, I am excited about the opportunity to contribute to your mission of advancing AI research and innovation in Nepal.

In my current role at Episto, I manage WordPress sites using Elementor and Astra, perform on-page SEO, and write keyword-targeted content. I have hands-on experience with HTML, CSS, JS, and PHP, and I am comfortable troubleshooting bugs and optimizing site performance. My personal project, mirook.com, involved building a multi-page WordPress site, implementing structured data, and conducting technical SEO/GEO audits to improve search visibility.

I am detail-oriented, self-motivated, and eager to learn. I am particularly drawn to NAAMII's focus on using AI for social good and would be thrilled to support your website as a gateway to your research and initiatives.

I have attached my CV and a link to my portfolio. Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the possibility of contributing to your team.

Best regards,

Baver Ok

cover_letter:
Dear NAAMII Hiring Team,

I am excited to apply for the Website Management Intern position at NAAMII. As a junior digital marketer with a technical foundation in web development and content management, I am eager to contribute to your mission of building a sustainable AI research ecosystem in Nepal.

In my current role as a Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I manage client websites built on WordPress, using Elementor and the Astra theme. I handle everything from content updates to full page builds, ensuring sites are responsive, functional, and aligned with branding. I also perform on-page SEO, including keyword research and technical audits, using tools like SEMrush, Ahrefs, and Google Search Console. This experience has made me proficient in HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, with working knowledge of PHP for backend customizations.

My personal project, mirook.com, showcases my ability to build and optimize a website from scratch. I designed and developed a multi-page WordPress site, implemented structured data (JSON-LD schema) for better search visibility, and conducted iterative technical SEO/GEO audits to improve performance. This project demonstrates my attention to detail and my commitment to staying current with web standards and best practices.

I am particularly drawn to NAAMII's focus on using AI to drive innovation in low- and middle-income countries. I am eager to apply my skills to support your website as a key communication tool for your research, education, and industry initiatives. I am a quick learner, self-motivated, and comfortable working both independently and collaboratively.

I would welcome the opportunity to contribute to your team and grow under the mentorship of experts at NAAMII. Thank you for considering my application.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
